summary: Starter Set rules chunk 3/5 (byte range 63824–92833): ACTION & MOVEMENT / CLOSE COMBAT / RANGED COMBAT. 16 headings, 10 cross-reference anchors, 2 rules tables (FULL ACTIONS, RANGED ATTACK MODIFIERS), 2 evexamplebox rules examples (Hayes defending, Nat shooting), 2 sidebar boxes (TOKENS & MINIATURES, MARK YOUR ACTIONS), 15 dice-symbol spans. All 15 basesymbol/stresssymbol spans reproduced byte-identically including their NBSP payloads and NBSP adjacency; all 68 NBSPs preserved; the sole U+2212 (Target Size "−2 dice") preserved as U+2212, and the 7 en-dashes that are numeric modifiers kept as U+2013 while the 10 prose en-dashes became "——" per ST-J02/J03 precedent. Terminology follows the already-shipped sibling units ST-J02/ST-J03 (完整动作/快速动作/打断动作/追骰/压力等级/精神强度/濒死/爬行管道/指示物/先攻牌) and the system lock for every skill and mechanic name. Upstream defects were preserved rather than silently repaired: the stray literal ">" at the end of Action Reset, the missing dice glyph in Giving Orders, and the two mis-targeted data-hash values (body-armor link points at critical-injuries, Defend's opposed-roll link points at relieving-stress) — data-hash values are byte-identical, only the labels are translated.

The 8 that are live data-hash targets in the corpus (foot-movement, leaving-combat, close-combat, special-attacks, ranged-combat, cover, ammunition, full-auto) all resolve. Ampersand headings follow the ST-J03 precedent (combat-initiative, surprise-ambush), NOT the '-and-' form — matching Foundry's actual derivation.

glossary_gaps.why: One of the six life-cycle names PROJECT.md §7.2.0 marks as unsettled. Appears once, in Target Size ('a small object, such as … a Chestburster'). 破胸体 is the dominant Chinese-fandom rendering and is a noun (体) matching the sibling stage names' shape better than the agent-noun 破胸者. Used consistently; no second form appears anywhere in this unit. ST-J27 owns the 'Stage III: Chestburster' heading and must adopt the same string.

Quick-action list item 'Rally a broken character'; no glossary entry and no lang key. 鼓舞 is the established TRPG rendering and reads correctly against 濒死 (Broken): you talk them back onto their feet rather than heal them. Flagging because the mechanic is defined in a later chunk (Broken, ST-J05) and both must agree.
Full Auto section, 4 occurrences. ALIENRPG.FullAuto pins 全自动 for the weapon property but there is no term for the act. 连射 keeps the property name free and is unambiguous against 全自动.

One of four special attacks (缴械/越过/推开/擒抱). Chose 越过 over 突过 to stay a natural 2-char verb parallel with its three siblings; 穿过 was rejected because it reads as passing through the enemy rather than past them.
Same 4-item parallel set. 推开 covers both 'push to Short range' and 'shove through a door'.
Same set; 擒抱 is the standard TRPG term and supports the derived 擒抱攻击 in the same paragraph.
Heading, id friendly-fire. 友军火力 is a literal calque that reads as a support asset; 误伤 states the mechanic (you hit the unintended target).
Used ONLY as the Full Cover link label; the heading itself lives in ST-J05 (DAMAGE chapter), which is not yet translated. If ST-J05 picks a different word my label goes stale — controller sync point.
Link label. Already used by ST-J02 for the identical data-hash, so this is a confirmation, not a new proposal.

In the RANGED COMBAT example. Treated as T-LATIN for the maker + model designation (PROJECT.md §3.4) with only the common noun Pistol translated; short-form 'her Rexim' kept as Rexim. The corerules pack ships the sibling item 'Rexim RXF-M5A3 EVA Pistol' which will need a T-BILINGUAL name — if that name lands on a different transliteration, this prose mention should follow it.

Sidebar title. ⚠ ST-J03 renders the SAME English phrase as '标记与模型' in its Maps section (evolvedlinestart label). I chose 指示物 because it is Foundry's own word (ALIENRPG.NoToken 你没有选中任何指示物, ALIENRPG.DefProto 原型指示物) and because ST-J03's own body prose says 纸质指示物. One of the two should be changed — see open_issues.
The action row sits next to a skill column reading 机械 (Heavy Machinery, R5). 使用机械 would print 机械 twice on one row for two different things; 使用机器 keeps the object distinct from the skill.

open_issues: TERM COLLISION with ST-J03: the English 'Tokens & Miniatures' is rendered 标记与模型 in ST-J03 (Maps section, evolvedlinestart label) and 指示物与微缩模型 here (sidebar title). Same English string, same journal page, two Chinese forms. I recommend ST-J03 move to 指示物 — its own body text already says 纸质指示物 and 微缩模型, and 指示物 is what the Foundry UI itself says (ALIENRPG.NoToken / ALIENRPG.DefProto). Controller decision.

SLUG CONVENTION divergence between the two already-shipped units: ST-J03 uses the true Foundry-derived slug for ampersand headings (combat-initiative, surprise-ambush) while ST-J02 uses an '-and-' form (base-dice-and-stress-dice) and one form with a literal '?' (whats-the-story-mother?). I followed ST-J03, which is the correct derivation — Foundry's String#slugify turns '&' into a replacement run that collapses, it never spells 'and'. This also explains why the register lists surprise-and-ambush and combat-and-initiative as 'not resolving today': those are pre-existing upstream data-hash bugs, and ST-J03 correctly did NOT paper over them. ST-J02's base-dice-and-stress-dice has no data-hash pointing at it so it is inert, but whats-the-story-mother? is not a slugify output at all and is worth a pass.

UPSTREAM DEFECT preserved (Giving Orders): the English reads 'For every you roll, they get +1 die' — a dice-symbol span was dropped upstream, so the sentence has no object. I mirrored the gap (你每掷出一个，对方就…) rather than inventing 成功, because supplying the missing glyph would be adding rules content. If the controller prefers, the fix is to insert a basesymbol span here — but that would change the tag multiset and must be a deliberate, packaged upstream-repair decision, not a translator's edit.

UPSTREAM DEFECT preserved (two mis-targeted links): 'Damage may be reduced by body armor (…)' links to data-hash="critical-injuries" and Defend's 'turns the attack into an opposed roll (…)' links to data-hash="relieving-stress". Both should point at Armor and Opposed Rolls respectively. data-hash left byte-identical per §3.6; labels translated to match the sections they actually point at (重伤 / 缓解压力), which is what ST-J02 and ST-J03 already do for these same two anchors. Do not 'fix' the label without fixing the hash.
UPSTREAM TYPO not reproduced: 'enemies in the adjacent zone..' has a doubled period. Chinese uses a single 。 — punctuation doubling carries no information and no code reads it.

'Full Action' is rendered 完整动作, NOT the lang value 慢速动作 (ALIENRPG.SlowAction). This is deliberate and follows ST-J03: Evolved renamed Slow/Fast Action to Full/Quick Action, and cn.json's 慢速动作 is keyed to the classic term. 快速动作 happens to match ALIENRPG.FastAction byte-for-byte, so only the Full side is unpinned. If the controller ever adds an ALIENRPG.FullAction key it must be 完整动作 to stay in lockstep with ST-J03 and this unit.

The two evblockquoteCenter boxes in this unit (QUICK ACTIONS list, MARK YOUR ACTIONS tip) are rules furniture, not read-aloud text, despite the class. Registered them as instructional prose rather than spoken horror register — the read-aloud rule applies to the adventure chapters, not this rules chapter.
